target_column.description: Name of the categorical column Mitra classifies. Its distinct values are the class labels (2–10 classes). Every other non-dropped column is a feature.

drop_columns.description: Comma-separated columns to exclude from features (e.g. ids, dates already encoded). Leave blank to keep all.

max_train_rows.description: Cap on training rows. Mitra's hard upstream ceiling is 10000; larger tables are seed-sampled down.

validation_split.description: Fraction of train held out for the reported accuracy when the zip has no val.csv.

time_limit_seconds.description: AutoGluon fit time budget in seconds.

seed.description: RNG seed. Mitra's fit is stochastic; pin this for reproducible runs.

eval_metric.description: Metric AutoGluon optimizes and reports. All listed metrics apply to binary and multiclass targets.

fine_tune.description: Fine-tune Mitra's weights (needs a GPU) versus zero-shot in-context inference. On a CPU instance the pipeline runs zero-shot regardless of this setting.

fine_tune_steps.description: Number of fine-tuning steps when fine_tune is on. 0 uses AutoGluon's default. Ignored for zero-shot.
